item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will still be very hot over Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be more showers and a few squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. With the upper-air disturbance departing, showers will ease off over the region in the latter part of this week. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea over the weekend to midweek next week. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will intensify gradually and bring very hot weather to southeastern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will move slowly towards Kyushu of Japan in the next couple of days. It will then recurve to the northeast and move across the western part of Japan.
